name: leapctl
description: Manage a Lutron Caséta / RA2 Select system over LEAP: see and change what every remote button does, schedules, rooms and names, add devices, with automatic backups and undo.

host.title: Bridge address
host.description: IP address of your Lutron bridge. Leave empty if you ran `leapctl setup`.

cert.title: Client certificate
cert.description: LEAP client certificate (from Home Assistant or `lap-pair`). Leave empty if you ran `leapctl setup`.

key.title: Client key
key.description: The certificate's private key. Leave empty if you ran `leapctl setup`.
